say:1:1330356001:1.text: You bet. Even when the festivities end, I'll still be here, selling sapphirine blossoms to honor our fallen heroes.
say:1:1330356001:1.source_cn: 当然还有，就算祭典结束了，我也不会放弃卖蓝绒花的。

say:2:1330356002:1.text: Now that the truth is out about the undead being our former warriors, locals are buying them year-round to pay their respects.
say:2:1330356002:1.source_cn: 现在大家都知道活死人的身份了，本地人也开始买来纪念战士...
